title: UserProvisioningLog - Data API
description: Represents messages generated during the process of provisioning users for third-party applications. This object is available in API version 33.0 and later.

Details.description: The value of this field depends on the log entry. For example, if the target system returns an error, the error message may be recorded in this field.

ExternalUserId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Nillable, Sort, Update
ExternalUserId.description: The unique identifier for the user in the target system.

ExternalUsername.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ExternalUsername.description: The username set in the target system for the associated user account.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: The unique name for this object.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: Salesforce ID of the Group or User who owns this object.

Status.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Status.description: The status of the user provisioning request. Based on the context of the log, it can contain different values, such as an HttpStatusCode.

UserId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
UserId.description: Salesforce ID of the user making the request. This is a relationship field.

UserProvisioningRequestId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
UserProvisioningRequestId.description: A unique identifier for the user provisioning request. This is a relationship field.
